unit: canvas px at close-up scale (gap from row 2's ink top to the card's top edge divided by the camera scale: 668 -> 225, i.e. the card rises 443 close-up px = 248 px on screen at the rest scale x0.560)
sampling: captured pictures only (24/30 fps cadence on the 60 fps grid)
note: P4 picture card entrance during the camera pull-back: the 16:9 rounded picture card rises into its slot under the rows from below the frame (first seen f3279 as a smeared top edge at the bottom of the frame), decelerating to rest by about f3296; its own rise is separated from the pull-back by dividing the row-2-to-card gap by the camera scale (scratch/v7c5_p4_pullback_rowy.csv); no fade (card luma 110 from f3284) and no scale change relative to the rows (card width / camera scale constant within 1% from f3284); card top from the ink bands, row-2 top from the text ink (scratch/v7c5_p4_card_rise2.csv)
